resources.string: Download a language model once, check it, and run it on this tablet without a network.
Choose a model and download it once. After that it runs on this tablet, without a network.
Downloads a model file once from %1$s. Nothing you type leaves the device.
This device is not on Wi-Fi or another unmetered network. The files are large (2.6 to 3.7 GB): Wi-Fi is recommended.
Checking the file\'s SHA-256. This takes a moment.
Use the file pushed with adb
The file (%1$s) is removed from this tablet. You can download it again later.
Installed and checked. It is ready to use.
There is not enough free space for this model and a safety margin. Free some space and try again.
The download stopped (%1$s). Tap Resume download to continue where it stopped.
The server refused the download (%1$s). Try again later.
The download was sent somewhere it may not go, so it was stopped.
The file was not the expected size, so it was deleted.
The file\'s SHA-256 did not match the expected value, so it was deleted and not used. Try again.
Test bench for the on-device model. Push a model file with adb, pick it, run the fixed prompt, then copy the numbers. Everything runs on this device; nothing is sent anywhere.
No model file found yet. Push one with adb into the folder below, then tap Refresh.
Loading the model. This can take a minute.
Done. The numbers are under Results.
The file is not the expected size, so it was not loaded. If adb is still copying it, wait and tap Run again.
The file\'s SHA-256 does not match, so it was deleted and not loaded. Push it again.
The adb folder is not available: it needs Android 11 or later and shared storage mounted.
